title: Sheet-metal base flange from arbitrary polygons
summary: Base flanges are no longer rectangle-only — pass any CCW outline (with optional CW hole loops) and the rest of the pipeline (unfold, DXF, DFM, cost, hems, jogs) just works.
details:
## What's New

- **`SheetMetalBaseFlangePolygon` IR op** (Rust + TS): outline + holes + thickness + material.
- **`base_flange_polygon_with_holes` kernel function** exported from `vcad-kernel-sheet`; the existing `base_flange_rect` is now a thin wrapper.
- **`sheet_metal_create` MCP tool** accepts `outline` (array of `{x,y}` or `[x,y]` points) and `holes`; takes precedence over `width`/`depth`. Holes appear in the flat pattern and on the CUT layer of the layered DXF.
- Flanges, hems, jogs, DFM, cost, and the AI self-heal loop all keep working because every downstream system reads the panel outline/holes directly.
